summary: Implemented default general web search using the official DuckDuckGo HTML endpoint, preserving explicit Wikipedia fallback, restricted article reader and arithmetic. No paid provider, credential, budget, authorization or billing pipeline changes.

checks.command: node --input-type=module (stdin: import createResearchTools; execute default search for Canada official government)

review.scope: Root independently reviewed pinned DNS/TLS, strict source parsing, body limits, challenge handling and absence of result-site fetches; root reported 51/51 focused integration checks passed.

limitations: DuckDuckGo HTML search is a best-effort public source, not a purchased API or SLA. Challenges and outages fail closed without bypass or automatic retries.
Root must verify the deployed exact commit and authenticated search from the Railway production origin.
Article reading remains restricted to English Wikipedia summaries; returned search destination URLs are never fetched by the server.
